name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Values per category or period as bars, grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal.

when: Comparing values across categories or periods.
Explaining a change between two totals.

instead.when: A ranked list of names with values reads better.

keyboard.does: Moves between data points; the tooltip follows.

builtIn: A "Show as table" button shows the same data as a table, which screen readers get by default.
youProvide: A title that says what the figure is.

genui.description: Values per category. Rows are categories or periods; categories are the numeric columns (a stack holds at most five).
